Bremner,](http://scispace.com/authors/murray-r-bremner-gcu01565am)[Irvin Roy Hentzel](http://scispace.com/authors/irvin-roy-hentzel-4zu46p7xjp) +1 more[University of Saskatchewan,](http://scispace.com/institutions/university-of-saskatchewan-ep82959d)[Iowa State University](http://scispace.com/institutions/iowa-state-university-a6g8atpr) -30 Jun[2001](http://scispace.com/journals/communications-in-algebra-144tpgns/2001) -[Communications in Algebra](http://scispace.com/journals/communications-in-algebra-144tpgns) -Vol. 29, Iss: 8, pp 3523-3534 Show Less Podcast 17 [PDF](https://lib.dr.iastate.edu/cgi/viewcontent.cgi?article=1140&context=math_pubs) Save Cite TL;DR: In this paper, the Cayley-Dickson process is used to construct noncommutative Jordan algebras of dimension 2 n for all n ≥ 0, beginning with any ring of scalars. Abstract:The Cayley-Dickson process gives a recursive method of constructing a nonassociative algebra of dimension 2 n for all n ≥ 0, beginning with any ring of scalars. The algebras in this sequence are known to be flexible quadratic algebras; it follows that they are noncommutative Jordan algebras: they satisfy the flexible identity in degree 3 and the Jordan identity in degree 4. For the integral sedenion algebra (the double of the octonions) we determine a complete set of generators for the multilinear identities in degrees ≤ 5. Since these identities are satisfied by all flexible quadratic algebras, it follows that a multilinear identity of degree ≤ 5 is satisfied by all the algebras obtained from the Cayley-Dickson process if and only if it is satisfied by the sedenions. read more [Show Related Papers](http://scispace.com/search?q=Identities+for+algebras+obtained+from+the+cayley-dickson+process) ##### Chat with Paper * Explain Abstract of this paper * Conclusions from the paper * Results of the paper Show more ##### AI Agents for this Paper * Find similar papers on Google Scholar, PubMed and Arxiv * Write a critical review of this paper * Analyze citations of this paper to find unaddressed research gaps Show more ##### Citations Sort by: Citation Count PDF Open Access Filters Showing all 17 results •Book [Non-Associative Normed Algebras -------------------------------](http://scispace.com/papers/non-associative-normed-algebras-4y3hfynbi3) [Miguel Cabrera García,](http://scispace.com/authors/miguel-cabrera-garcia-4cpspvwqey)[Angel Rodríguez Palacios](http://scispace.com/authors/angel-rodriguez-palacios-363qetop32) +1 more[University of Granada](http://scispace.com/institutions/university-of-granada-1y8kosch) -10 May 2018 Show Less -
